title: Work done by student
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly compute the work done as the initial kinetic energy, yielding 7.5 J.

title: Pre-collision horizontal velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly compute the horizontal velocity just before collision as v1*sin(53°) = 4 m/s.

title: Post-collision horizontal velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly compute the post-collision horizontal velocity v3 from the projectile motion to the basket, yielding 3 m/s.

title: Average horizontal force
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly apply the impulse-momentum theorem to find the average horizontal force, yielding 420 N.

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important Criteria: The solution should correctly apply the work-energy theorem to relate the work done to the initial kinetic energy.

title: Projectile motion analysis
description: Important Criteria: The solution should correctly analyze the projectile motion after the collision to relate h, L, g, and v3.

title: Impulse-momentum setup
description: Important Criteria: The solution should correctly set up the impulse-momentum equation for the horizontal collision with the backboard.

title: Sign error in impulse
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student makes a sign error in the impulse-momentum equation (e.g., incorrect direction for v3).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The solution demonstrates consistent use of SI units (J, m/s, N) throughout the calculations.
